notes.title: VZX Player v0.9.7.0 Released
notes.content:
Does this new release cause problems?

With every new release there is the risk for some hiccups. We have tried our best to test and have had a public beta, but there can always be something.

We would like to try to help you fix any issues. Please report issues in our discord server. In 95% of cases bugs affect others too. Using the review system to write a negative review to report bugs/crashes is not very good for you since it makes it difficult for us to get back to you - our reply results in a Steam notification and it might drown in all other notifications.


What you can do right now about problems
Previous releases are available in "betas" in the Steam settings for VZX Player so you can still run "what worked before" until we have been able to fix the problems in the new release.

[strike]AVX2 Support Required[/strike]
Edit \[2025-06-27]: We're skipping this for now.

[strike]We now require AVX2 support in your CPU.[/strike]

[strike]If your CPU does not have this, we have a version without it that you can opt-in to:[/strike]

[strike]Right-click VZX Player and selece "Properties"[/strike]

[strike]Click "Betas"[/strike]

[strike]In the dropdown menu, click on v0.9.7_no_avx2[/strike]

[strike]Steam should now download this version[/strike]

[strike]No need to fill in the password field[/strike]


Offline Support (beta, kind of)
This version supports a truly offline mode, without Steam client running. 

It works by generating licensing files that create a hash of the application+DLC id, time-out date and some info about the computer it's running on. These offline licenses are generated automatically when you run the application with Steam running.



The offline license files are:

not using anything from any servers online (other than the fact that they are generated when Steam is running)

not sent to any servers online

not compared with anything from the internet

only stored as files locally in your %LOCALAPPDATA%

only compared locally

not synchronized with Steam cloud (only %APPDATA%/vovoid/vzx_store_player is, this is the same as before)

When no Steam running, these hashes are then generated again when launching the application and comparing with the stored files. If they match - it's running on the right computer.


Hopefully this will be totally invisible except for when the licenses time out after a while.
Then just running the application with Steam again renews the license.


Bug Fixes
Text editor could behave weirdly when the first character was an empty space. This is fixed.

When a game device (gamepad etc) was removed, a crash would occur.

Since the %APPDATA%\\vovoid (roaming) directory is synchronized with Steam cloud, the log file is moved to a new %LOCALAPPDATA%\\vovoid directory. This is also where the offline license files are located.


Misc Features and Improvements
All edit boxes support selection and clipboard operations

Intel ARC GPUs, while not tested and officially supported by us, has been reported to work to some extent. The Intel warning dialog still appears, but you can now opt out of it.


Other Improvements
Many engine improvements which can be used in future visual packs.


Steam Deck / Proton / Linux
This is not supported but we've done some limited testing on there, seems this release doesn't work... That's unfortunate, but the previous version worked at time of testing. More details in this thread: https://steamcommunity.com/app/981590/discussions/0/838346115741913574/


Thanks to beta testers
Thank you all who helped out with running the beta_0.9.7 branch!

notes.title: Public beta test for v0.9.7.0
notes.content:
Hi,

we invite you to try a public beta which is available in the beta branch:

"beta_0.9.7"

 select "Properties"
 select "Betas"
 click the drop-down to select "beta_0.9.7"

You'll know you've succeeded in when the window title says version "0.9.7.0".

About this version
This is primarily a regression test. As in - make sure nothing's broken.
We appreciate you testing it out a lot, while we do test all we can, we need more computer configurations to rule out bugs.

What's new?

Offline Support
This version supports a truly offline mode, without Steam client running. 
It works by generating licensing files that match the application+DLC and the computer it's running on.

These offline licenses are generated when you run the application with Steam running.

Hopefully this will be totally invisible except for when the licenses time out after a while.
Then just running the application with Steam again renews the license.

Bug Fixes

 Text editor could behave weirdly when the first character was an empty space. This is fixed.
 When a game device (gamepad etc) was removed, a crash would occur.


Misc Features and Improvements

All edit boxes support selection and clipboard operations
Intel ARC, while not tested and officially supported by us, has been reported to work to some extent. The Intel warning dialog still appears, but you can now opt out of it.


Other Improvements

Many engine improvements which can be used in future visual packs.


I have something to report!
First, check the list of known issues available here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/981590/discussions/0/603028545007018849/

If it's addressed there, you don't have to report it.

It's not on the list, where do I report it?
Please join our discord server ( click the icon below ) and report it in the channel #development.

notes.title: VZX Player v0.9.6.0 Released

 Other engine improvements, preparing for future releases.


NVIDIA GPU VRAM analysis report
TLDR:

All visuals loaded from all DLC packs:

 1080p: ~4GB VRAM (down 50%)
 2160p: ~8GB VRAM (down 70%)


The full report:

While written for the Pro Player (a part of VZX Creative), a lot of the internals is the same, so the numbers should be good - but perhaps not quite as dramatic:
https://www.vzx-visualizer.com/vzx_creative/vzx_pro_player_visual_vram_optimization_results.pdf

notes.title: VZX Player v0.9.4 Released
notes.content:
Does this new release cause problems?

With every new release there is the risk for some hiccups. We have tried our best to test and have had a public beta, but there can always be something.

We would like to try to help you fix any issues. Please report issues in our discord server. In 95% of cases bugs affect others too. Using the review system to write a negative review to report bugs/crashes is not very good for you since it makes it difficult for us to get back to you - many people ignore Steam notifications.

What you can do right now about problems

Previous releases (including v0.9.3.1) is available in "betas" in the Steam settings for VZX Player so you can still run "what worked before" until we have been able to fix the problems in the new release.


About this version
This isn't a huge release in terms of actual features, but it's pretty huge under the hood, preparing for future releases.

New Feature: Auto Gain

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36137962/594c53c2f31a5f8404e4eeeb5804c4d9a2dbea5b.png

Previously you had to have your music player on max volume for the visuals to work correctly. With auto gain enabled, the player will try to nudge the gain up all the time until reaching a set attenuation value. From our not-so-accurate manual "this feels good"-testing, -1.0 db seems to be a good attenuation value.

New Visual Pack: With one visual

What? Only one visual in a pack??

The pack is free for all, and a special "beta" pack. Reason for this is the visual is using our new graphics engine, so by using it you help out solidifying this pretty huge (in terms of code) new addition to the graphics backend.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36137962/de1bbdd69429037cc733615f39a1eadd8870bc41.png

This visual shouldn't be enabled by default, you have to explicitly enable it.

If everything works well, this visual will be added to the other free visuals in an upcoming release.

No more Watermark

You no longer have to buy DLC to get rid of the watermark. It doesn't exist!

DLC improvements

 Smooth spectrum dark's colors can now be customized


Bug fixes

 A crash in the audio receiving code has been fixed.
 A crash in the price updater which occurred when having no internet connection )or flaky DNS resolving capability) might have been fixed.


Config and playlist files are now versioned
In %APPDATA%\vovoid\vzx_store_player you find the config files. These are in JSON. This version will read old files to the best of its ability but save new ones with the version number. This means that if you go back to older versions (which don't have features like auto gain etc), you will also go back to the settings you had then. The reason for this is there is a crash (null pointer exception) in previous versions if there are references to non-existent packs in the playlist json, so we decided to also add version numbers to other config files. The tweak files are the same however, a visual rarely loses options.

Thanks to beta testers

We saw almost 4% of users during one week helping out with testing. Thank you!

notes.title: VZX Player v0.9.3.1 Patch Release
notes.content:
Improvements:

 On dual GPU gaming laptops with NVidia or AMD GPUs where an Intel HD Graphics GPU is also present, VZX player should now start on the discrete GPU by default even if the control panel is set to use the Intel HD Graphics by default. This could solve issues for laptop users and hopefully prevents some crashes which inevitably happen when starting on Intel HD Graphics. Also means you don't have to change the setting to make VZX Player work.
 A garbled dialog showing when Steam is not started has been fixed.
 The garbled one-time question about ignoring intel cards has been removed. Instead a warning if you launch the player on an Intel GPU comes up every time.
 Added some minor logging for the tweak bar in an attempt to diagnose a rare crash the we have seen but which is hard to understand.


Bug fixes:

 Watermark was not updated with VZX Logo.


If this version causes problems for you, you can go back to a number of previous versions.

They are available under Settings -> Betas along with release date.

Let us know in our discord if you have any problems!

notes.title: VSXu Player 0.9.1 Released
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36137962/b55b28843a874d470751acd462924ca8a4a04eb4.png
New Luna Design, get the desktop wallpaper in our discord!

Getting Support

Important! If you experience bugs/problems:
With every new release there are going to be some hiccups. We have tried our best to test thoroughly and have had an extensive public beta, but there is always something.

We would like to try to help you fix any issues. Please contact us at support@vovoid.com or via our discord server. In 95% of cases bugs affect others too so investigating is worth it. Using the review system to write a negative review is not very good for you since it makes it difficult for us to get back to you - many people ignore Steam notifications.

What you can do right now about problems

The previous release is available as "previous_version" in "betas" in the Steam settings for VSXu so you can still run "what worked before" until we have helped you fix the problems in the new release.


Now on to the new stuff...

VSXu Player 0.9.1 Release Notes

The New Audio Engine
Main point is stability and fixing crashes and audio errors people were having when using the WASAPI backend. Here's the complete list:


Entirely new audio backend which solves "no sound" driver issues which manifested as multiple crashes right when starting VSXu Player when one has certain peripherals connected.
Seems to fix the “Unknown HRESULT” issue when recording audio which happened to quite a few users.
API Selection now moved inside the player, no need to restart it to switch between audio APIs.
WASAPI: Audio reporting rate has increased from 42Hz to 100Hz which makes a big difference on monitors that can do more than 60 Hz
WASAPI backend used to downsample/resample the audio which caused issues with the frequency response. DirectSound and ASIO might still use this resampling, which will possibly be addressed in a future update.
The new audio backend is implemented as 3 EXE files - one per API type. They communicate back to the player over UDP packets via localhost. This shouldn’t need any port openings in the Windows Firewall but you will see the open ports in some port monitoring software.


Design Improvements

Luna has been redesigned


Font rendering engine

While it should not be visible, the font rendering system is totally new. This improves performance quite a bit and does not rely on old OpenGL API calls.


Performance improvements

GUI drawer was rendered even though not visible


Improvements to Visualizations
Generally, the updated visuals have been given (more) color customizations (tweaks). Full list as follows:

Classics pack

Plane Worlds: New granular color handling.
Techno Stripes: You can now set line thickness.
Glowstick Hyperspace: Added full color tweak support.
Kaleidoscope: Judging from the community screenshots, this one is quite popular. It's gotten a larger overhaul with improved gamma correction, bloom and better color tweaks.



Particle Bliss pack

Anemone: Now limiting particle size in the visual so it doesn't get too intense.
Exploding Star: Reduced default FX level somewhat. Less jumpy in 120 FPS. Added color support.
Exploding Star Slow: Color support


Spectrums & Oscilloscopes pack

Space Spectrum: The particle fountain in the middle now follows the color of the round spectrum.
3D Oscilloscope: Default FX level reduced a bit. Feedback color can now be changed.
Polar Oscilloscope Wave: More color tweaking supported.


Networks pack

Cyber Dive: Secondary color can be changed.
Spectrum Flight: Proper color selection instead of separated sliders.
Spectrum Pool: Full color selection support added.
Three Body: Full color selection support added.
Dream Pool: Full color selection support added.


Hope you like the new release.
Next we are going to be working on a new visual pack as well as Artiste and the Pro Player.
As always, if you have questions/feeeback you are welcome to join our discord server which is redirected to from http://vovoid.info.

Take care!

VSXu Player Improvements

New Localizations

German
French
Swedish


We would really like more translations.

If you want to help out, please contact any of the devs in the discord, or send mail to info@vovoid.com!


Mouse wheel support
You can now change FX level, Time and Speed with the mouse wheel. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36137962/7545a437a382c1393e04bdfbcd8f0666e7fc8a36.png
While an arrow is missing here, time is also possible to change, but not with shift key modifier.

Settings and Tweak bars now have close "X" buttons to make mouse navigation better.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36137962/463749441a6192713e9d71de90eb9e7e1f5cb84f.png

When hitting ESC or closing from full screen mode with X button in the top right corner, you now get an exit prompt. Before one could accidentally hit ESC which was a problem.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36137962/7b3391a2ada388e6c9bf46b883e484f10edcd755.png

Audio device names now list the "sub name" under the primary name. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36137962/80e7b766e1b907200223f8e55b670f6438b6fb68.png

Color spectrum on standalone hue sliders

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36137962/f57206e92b5533218058cb7b3095025c44334060.png

The Hue slider had a gray background in the previous version.


New visuals added to existing packs
Four new spectrums have been added to the "Spectrums and Oscilloscopes" DLC pack. Here's a screenshot from one of them:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36137962/c5839ed25d023afa221fa6d670829cc4247aa6bb.png

Note that only one of them has customizable color, this is because they use a new gradient generator which isn't easy to manipulate. 

Bug Fixes

 An audio subsystem related crash (an unhandled exception) has been fixed. The error message will now be displayed in red if such an error is triggered.
 Errors in audio subsystem will now show up in red in the player.


Possible / known bugs

 If a visual looks weird it could be because its tweak values have been loaded in a weird way. We tried to sort this out but could not see a pattern to it. If this happens to you, go to the tweak bar [T] and press the "Reset" button. Should only be needed once. If you have any insight into under what circumstances this would happen, please let us know!

 During testing we saw a rare bug where memory usage would increase a lot. This was possibly fixed, but regardless, being so hard to reproduce it could also not be fixed. 

If you experience this (memory usage above 2GB, normal memory usage with all visuals from all packs loaded is 900MB), please forward us your log files to support@vovoid.com. Thanks!


Access to the previous version of the player
It is always possible that we have made a mistake in development which can take a while to sort out. Starting with this release, you can access the previous version of VSXu which hopefully works, until we have sorted out the bugs. To do so, go to properties and select "betas" tab, and activate the beta branch "previous version".

What's next?
Our intention is to shift development focus to VSXu Artiste - our visuals editor. We hope to be able to get it up to speed and release it on Steam in the near future (as soon as it's good enough).

If you are not familiar with VSXu Artiste, it's a node-based programming language for creating graphics. You can play around with an old version if you download it from www.vsxu.com. However that version is quite old, and there is a lot of new things in the currently unreleased version. 

While there is a lot to be said about this topic, one thing that Artiste creators want is the ability to play back their visuals with the player and that has been rather tricky in the past. So we are going to try to create a way to do that inside Artiste - a player mode if you will. The old player can then be retired.

As always, we're available in our discord for chat and questions!

notes.title: VSXu Player and multiple instances
notes.content:
Today a small update was pushed which enables you to launch the player multiple times on one computer and at the same time as playing a game via Steam.

To do this, you have to execute the .EXE file directly from Windows - not through Steam.

If you right-click VSXu Player and select "Properties", you can find the tab "Local Files", if you click "Browse Local Files..." you should get an explorer window for the directory where VSXu has been installed. (Or if you know where your Steam library is - just go there with windows explorer.)

Once viewing this directory, double-click the "vsxu_store_player.exe" to start it.

Now it will still detect Steam and integrate with it and at the same time free up Steam for launching other things.

Creating WIndows Shortcut to VSXu Player
Being able to start it like this means you can also create a windows shortcut to it - for inclusion on desktop or task bar for instance.

Running a game and VSXu at the same time
This technique also enables you to run VSXu and a game at the same time - just don't start VSXu through Steam at all, but through the exe file directly and then launch the game on Steam like you do normally. Useful for the Streamers out there!

What was changed?
Since this is not a change in the code, the version number is still the same. All that was done was to add the file "steam_appid.txt".
